title: recover-P: STNFS core, run gate: expected total work 2^115.357246614832

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, uniform challenges and fresh coins, proof.md's algorithm returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 at expected total work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^116.7134121+2^66) < 2^115.357246614832 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000); every run below 2^118.420818 units. The coin is part of the one cold attack on the one target: the run reads one fresh 64-bit coin before any other work, then either stops at the charged closed-gate cost (a failure) or, with probability K/2^64, performs the whole attack; K=7205651145812838480 is least with (K/2^64) lo_run >= 0.39. The work is that one run's expected total work over the challenge and all coins; nothing is amortized over other targets or runs. lo_run=0.998415: each of the two logarithms gets 32 independent descent attempts on freshly randomised targets, each capped at 2^112.14 units and without retries inside the descent tree; the only descent premise (H5) is that one such attempt fails with probability at most 0.8 (union bound: at most 0.3058). Under H1-H5, H-EA, H-X and H-FFT.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit: code identity, parameters, probes, both ledgers, attempt union bound, opened-run success, gate K and K-1, claim; {} also prints toy_descent's default run (20 attempts). One key per run: {"descent": "tree"} descent recurrence; {"ideal": i} PREREG-E type i's worst ideal (0: boot).
Executed retry-free first-choice descent attempts on a toy tower NFS instance (quadratic base field, unit duplicates, up to 6 window primes per side) beside the package's union bound (DESCENT.md).
filtsim C4 quotient, means 744/501, weight 100/200/400: unit share (charged 0.86), U/N (H4u, H3).
